A '''sector army''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
An [[Army/Legends|Army]] was commanded by a [[Surface Marshal]], although the title was commonly given to the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] or [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] in command of a [[Sector Group/Legends|Sector Group]], due to the political complications of sector administration.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> It was composed of 1,180,309 personnel, 66,640 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 13,992 [[Tank|heavy tanks]].<ref name="ISB" /> A sector army consisted of two [[Systems army|systems armies]], while an augmented sector army consisted of four systems armies.<ref name="ISB2" /> Because of this, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] noted that the size of a sector army alone would make guerrilla efforts to dislodge Imperial Army control from the Core Worlds next to impossible.<ref name="IHB" />
